items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Bretta; the name is introduced solely by the interviewer ('He's Bretta. Ram, Bretta.')

ctx.x: Was Alfred William out there with them? I know, no. I know Alfred played with. But uh.

The right boy, what his name? Chum, which uh. I call his name once he was out there with us. Well that's what they call the Texas band. Yeah. Yeah. That's what they call the Texas band. Yeah. That's what they call the Texas band. Yeah. That's what they call the Texas band. Yeah. He's Bretta. Ram, Bretta. Well, if there's nothing else, I think we can just. Yeah, that's about all I can tell y'all. Unless you think Chris is close by. I don't know where Chris is at. No. I thought you said. No. We'll talk to your…
Any other uncles that played anything? No.
